question: {Expand: } (3m - 5n)²
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand using the standard algebraic identity directly: (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b².

Square of the first term: (3m)² = 9m²

Product of terms × 2: 2 × 3m × 5n = 30mn

Square of the second term: (5n)² = 25n²

Combine with negative middle term: 9m² − 30mn + 25n²

**∴ The correct answer is 9m² − 30mn + 25n².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression to expand: (3m − 5n)²

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Comparing the given expression with the formula, we set a = 3m and b = 5n.

⇒ Substituting the values into the formula:

⇒ (3m − 5n)² = (3m)² − 2 × (3m) × (5n) + (5n)²

⇒ Simplifying each term separately:

⇒ (3m)² = 9m²

⇒ 2 × 3m × 5n = 30mn

⇒ (5n)² = 25n²

⇒ Putting it all together:

⇒ 9m² − 30mn + 25n²

**∴ The correct answer is 9m² − 30mn + 25n².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identities

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

Difference of Squares

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Perfect Cubes

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)
